ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the entire visible surface, with high-intensity (white/cream) pixel spikes restricted to the lateral margins; estimated ratio of high-intensity to low-intensity pixels is 0.04.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous region of dark-tone pixels spanning the horizontal and vertical extent of both lobes. High-contrast, roughly circular geometric blobs are concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of the left and right fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central notch with an acute angle approximately measured at 35-40 degrees with a significant depth profile relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 2 to 8 pixels creating a jagged topographic profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory following a wide arc from the median notch to the lateral tips, tapering significantly at the terminal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized high-contrast clusters of circular white/beige pixel groups (barnacles) on the outer margins of both left and right fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions observed on the upper portion of the left lobe, showing higher intensity than the surrounding dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active epibiotic colonization (barnacles) adhering to the trailing edges and terminal tips of the flukes.
